body:
## Type
Bug fix / dependency and CI hardening

## Description
Resolve the remaining review blockers for PR #120. Separate the incompatible Coqui and Chatterbox dependency constraints into resolver-safe supported installation paths, bring the lockfile and audit policy into agreement, and fix the three full-suite regressions in Chatterbox model errors and GUI construction.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Coqui and Chatterbox use a resolver-consistent safe dependency strategy with documented supported install paths.
- [ ] The lockfile matches declared constraints and passes the existing dependency audit policy without adding suppressions for newly introduced vulnerabilities.
- [ ] `pytest tests/ -v --tb=short` passes completely under the supported Python 3.11 environment.
- [ ] Ruff, pre-commit, and CI-equivalent checks are green.
- [ ] Model downloads remain explicit user actions only.

## Metadata
- PR: #120
- Scope: dependency resolution, lockfile, regression fixes, CI verification
- Priority: blocking review feedback

## Reporter Context
The PR currently declares `transformers<5.0.0` while its universal lock selects Chatterbox 0.1.7 with `transformers==5.2.0`. Chatterbox 0.1.3–0.1.6 force an audited-vulnerable Transformers release. The full suite also reports one Chatterbox variant error-message regression and two GUI construction failures caused by an invalid Qt property.
title: fix: resolve PR #120 dependency and regression blockers
